notes.note: Validate reversed bounds inside the generator before entering the input loop; preserve scalar clamp comparison and min/max semantics by delegating each requested value to clamp.
notes.evidence: boltons/module.py:40-68 validates upper < lower before applying min(max(x, lower), upper); p1 explicitly requires first-iteration validation before the first item.

notes.note: Use O(k) binomial arithmetic calls after materializing only the positions, excluding bool explicitly from accepted integers. O(k) denotes arithmetic calls rather than fixed-cost bit complexity. Test small exhaustive rank inverses and a billion-element domain with short positions.
notes.evidence: more_itertools/module.py:42 defines public exports; :659 nth_combination uses math.comb and lexicographic combinations but creates tuple(iterable), so reusing it on range(n) would violate s1. p1 correctly chooses a separate direct combinatorial computation.

notes.note: Use binding.original.line for strict failure reporting, rather than reconstructing physical lines from stream contents; assign into a normal dict for last-value and first-insertion order. Test invalid bindings preceded by blank lines and following multiline values.
notes.evidence: dotenv/module.py:144 parse_binding records a mark before multiline whitespace and yields Original metadata for errors; :188 parse_stream is the correct unchanged parser seam. Binding.key is None for ignored bindings, and Binding.value distinguishes None from an explicit empty string.
